import zipfile,os,subprocess,tempfile,random
seed='/workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/avc_dec_fuzzer_seed_corpus.zip'
with zipfile.ZipFile(seed) as z:
    names=z.namelist()
    print(names)
    data=z.read(names[0])
print('seed len',len(data),data[:32].hex())
for extra in [b'\x00',b'\xff',b'\x00\x00',b'\xff\xff',b'\x00'*10,b'\xff'*10]:
    p='/tmp/test.bin'
    open(p,'wb').write(data+extra)
    r=subprocess.run(['./mvc_dec_fuzzer',p,'-runs=1'],stdout=subprocess.PIPE,stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
    print(extra,len(data+extra),r.returncode)
    if r.returncode!=0:
        print(r.stderr.decode('latin1','ignore')[:1000])
        break
